title: Best Ever Chocolate Brownies
steps: 1. Preheat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 20cm square tin with parchment.
2. Melt butter and dark chocolate together gently, then cool to room temperature.
3. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale, thick, and doubled in volume.
4. Gently fold cooled chocolate into eggs, then sift and fold in flour and cocoa.
5. Stir in white and milk chocolate chunks; pour batter into the prepared tin.
6. Bake 25–30 minutes until top is shiny and center barely wobbles. Cool completely.
